label: „Подкрепа“: щампетни едномесечни стачки в седем институции от 23 ноември
text: The administrative-staff union's relay of one-hour effective strikes starts Monday 23 Nov at the Social Assistance Agency (10:00–11:00), then the Employment Agency (24 Nov), the Labour Inspectorate EXEC (25 Nov), the Registry Agency (26 Nov, hour TBC), the Geodesy/Cartography/Cadastre Agency (27 Nov), the National Statistical Institute (30 Nov) and the National Social Security Institute (1 Dec). Demands: a flat €350 monthly increase, restoration of the seniority supplement, and equal treatment across state administration — costed at €54m, which the union wants written into the 2027 budget.
